page.layout: One centred title block at the top, with the author line and place of printing below it; an engraved woodcut ornament in the middle; the imprint at the foot.
page.notes:
Engraving: a rectangular woodcut ornament with a strapwork frame, scrolls and fruit or foliage at the corners, enclosing an oval scene of a figure with a tree or branches, set in the middle of the page. Not transcribed as text.
Transcription follows the printed letters, with u/v adjusted: "RERVM" and "NATVRALIVM" are given as RERUM and NATURALIUM, "AVTORE" and "AVBERTO" as AVTORE and AVBERTO (capital V in the printed form, read as a vowel/consonant as required). Long s is plain s, so "caufis" is read as causis and "grauissimorum" is given with v for the consonant (gravissimorum) per the u/v rule; please check against the scan if the exact printed form matters.
"FERNELII MED. LI-": the hyphen after LI is a pointed mark on the scan and is read as a line-end hyphen; it is not certain. Also check "IN IOAN." for a trailing stop.
Handwritten "2" at top right and faint marks on the page are not printed text and are omitted. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
